title: Security effort estimator & question-slicing pricing pilot for CAIQ responses
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Large enterprise customers submit SIG/CAIQs with widely varying effort. The current binary approach (free fast-path vs full enterprise review) creates unpredictable sales cycles and hidden costs for legal/SE.

Goal: Pilot a question-level effort estimator and a complementary pricing instrument ("security effort credits") that lets customers choose fast-lane paid assistance for high-effort questions. The feature will (1) break CAIQ/SIG into modular slices, (2) surface an engineering + security effort estimate per slice in the onboarding flow, and (3) offer an immediate paid purchase that triggers a prioritized response SLA and bundled evidence deliverables.

Success metrics: reduce average time-to-closed-security-questionnaire from 21 days -> <=10 days for paid lanes; increase NRR on enterprise deals with heavy questionnaires by +4%; track hours billed to security/SE and revenue from credits.

Out of scope for pilot: full automation of answers, crypto-signed attestations, or replacing existing enterprise legal review flow.
acceptance_criteria: Estimator UI integrated into onboarding flow and CAIQ upload page (mock->prod path) with per-question effort bands (Low/Medium/High) displayed
Backend API that returns effort-band and estimated hours for CAIQ sections; documented in open-api spec and used by Console UI
Security effort credits SKU created in billing and fronted by buy flow in Console (test-mode)
Pilot customers (3) opt into paid lane and receive SLA of 5 business days for high-effort questions
Baseline and pilot telemetry: time-to-first-draft, average hours per questionnaire, conversion-to-paid, CSAT after delivery
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Implement estimator prototype and internal demo. Phase 2 (4 weeks): Integrate buy flow, wire billing test SKU, select 3 pilot customers. Phase 3 (2 weeks): Monitor metrics, collect qualitative feedback, iterate. Gate decision: if time-to-closure improves >=40% for paid lane and pilot customers report CSAT >=8/10, progress to expanded alpha.
